newsitem.title: USA: Atlas Air to buy 10 Boeing jets - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Atlas Air to buy 10 Boeing jets - WSJ.

text.p: Atlas Air Inc has agreed to buy 10 jets from Boeing Co worth $1.68 billion at list prices, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Monday's electronic edition, the Journal said the purchase of the new 747-400 freighter jets was expected to be announced later today.

In the past, Atlas has acquired used 747-200 planes and operated them under longterm leases with major airlines. Although used airplanes are cheaper to buy, Atlas has found they can be expensive to maintain.
However, the company said it continues to expect the older 747-200s to remain a mainstay of its fleet.

One reason for the order of new 747-400s, the company said, is for the improved fuel economy, larger payloads and longer range that allows nonstop flights between Europe and Asia, which will allow it to charge higher hourly rates.
